metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace for gaffer. Add it from GitHub (claude plugin marketplace add ahocking/gaffer) or from a local clone by path, then install by name so a consumer repo can enable the plugin from a committed .claude/settings.json instead of a per-session --plugin-dir flag.

plugins.name: gaffer
plugins.description: Reusable, domain-agnostic orchestration layer: chief-engineer/architect/reviewer/implementer subagents, spec-driven chains, single-checkout feature-branch workflow (develop + orch/* branches), graduated-autonomy guided loop, task-packet template, and an approval guardrail with generic risk defaults plus per-repo extensions.
